Method of Attack: Configured virus scanning program to report false symptoms of malware or infections to convince consumers to purchase unnecessary computer repair and technical services
Impacted Systems: Consumer computers tested at Office Depot locations
Attack Vector: Fake malware scans generated by diagnostic software used by Office Depot and Office Max employees
Indicators of Compromise: False positive malware scan results from 'PC Health Check' software
Reports of malware symptoms triggered by answering yes to diagnostic questions
